chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzāz, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

One of our companions asked him, while I was with him, about the qunut in Jumuʿah. He said to him: “In the second rakʿah.” Abū Baṣīr said to him: “Some of your companions have narrated to us that you said: ‘In the first rakʿah.’” He said: “In the last.” Then when he saw the people’s inattentiveness regarding it, he said: “O Abā Muḥammad, in the first and the last.” After that, Abū Baṣīr said: “Before the rukuʿ or after it?” Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to him: “Every qunut is before the rukuʿ except Jumuʿah; for indeed the first rakʿah in it is before the rukuʿ, and the last is after the rukuʿ.”

key_terms.الْأَخِيرَةِ: the final, meaning here the second rakʿah
key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the supplicatory invocation performed in prayer

ai.seo_question: When is the qunut performed in Salat al-Jumuʿah according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the ruling of qunut in the Friday prayer. It states that Jumuʿah is distinct from other prayers: there is qunut in both the first and second rakʿahs, with the first before rukuʿ and the second after rukuʿ. The report clarifies an apparent ambiguity through the Imam’s final explicit statement.
